description: Update a coffee's own fields (roaster, origins, roast level, rest window, notes, rating…). Bag-shaped fields sent here (state, roast_date, bag_weight_g, grams_remaining, cost…) land on the coffee's CURRENT bag — use update_bag when it has more than one. Changing dial_category changes what the engine advises (G5, C10), so say why in the optional note.

acidity.description: Free text; roasters usually say low, medium or high

attachments.description: JSON or comma-separated list of attachments

best_by_date.description: Calendar day in YYYY-MM-DD format — a day, not a timestamp

body.description: Free text; roasters usually say low, medium or high

buy_date.description: Calendar day in YYYY-MM-DD format — a day, not a timestamp

dial_category.description: Dialing behavior class: classic = medium/traditional espresso roasts (chocolate/nut, balanced); dark = genuinely dark/roasty; the light categories cover Nordic and ultra-light styles.

frozen_at.description: Calendar day the bag went into the freezer, YYYY-MM-DD — a day, not a timestamp

grams_remaining.description: Override the computed grams left in the bag (weigh the bag, set what is actually there). Translated into weight_adjustment_g so bag_weight_g keeps recording the true bag size. 0 marks the bag finished; a positive value on a finished bag un-finishes it.

notes.description: The coffee's own description — roaster tasting notes, the dialing approach. Replaces the stored value; the optional reason is appended instead.

opened_date.description: Calendar day in YYYY-MM-DD format — a day, not a timestamp

elevation_max_m.description: Upper end of an elevation range; elevation_m is the lower end

roast_date.description: Calendar day in YYYY-MM-DD format — a day, not a timestamp

sweetness.description: Free text; roasters usually say low, medium or high

unfrozen_at.description: Calendar day the bag came out, YYYY-MM-DD — a day, not a timestamp

weight_adjustment_g.description: Grams consumed or lost OUTSIDE logged shots (spillage, unlogged brews). grams_remaining = bag_weight_g − logged doses − this. To force remaining to a known value X, set this to bag_weight_g − logged doses − X. Negative adds weight back.

reason.description: Optional free-text note, appended as an ordinary line to the coffee's notes — or to the current bag's bag_notes when the call changed only bag fields. Omit it and nothing is written.

name: update_bean
title: Update a coffee
